1.title: HEAL – QDR Metadata Bridge
1.description: Designed and built a production-grade web platform at Syracuse University OSPO to automate the transfer of study-level metadata between HEAL collections and the Qualitative Data Repository (QDR), a national archive for qualitative and mixed-method research data.
1.lineone: Architected and implemented an automated metadata pipeline to ingest, validate, transform, and synchronize JSON-based study metadata between HEAL and QDR, eliminating manual ingestion workflows.
1.lastone: Implemented JSON schema validation, metadata transformation logic, and REST API integrations to upload validated datasets into Dataverse (QDR backend), enabling scalable and reliable metadata publishing.

2.title: Data Storage Finder
2.tagline: Decision-support tool for research data storage
2.description: Developed a decision-support web application at Syracuse University OSPO to help faculty and students identify the most appropriate data storage solutions based on research needs, compliance requirements, and data sensitivity.
2.lineone: Designed and implemented a custom WordPress plugin that dynamically renders a guided survey workflow and maps user responses to recommended storage solutions.
2.lastone: Conducted faculty interviews and cross-department collaboration to curate storage options, and ensured accessibility compliance through responsive design and WAVE accessibility testing.

3.title: BookStore POS System
3.tagline: Mobile-first POS system for independent retailers
3.description: Designed and developed a full-stack mobile point-of-sale system for independent bookstore owners to manage sales, inventory, and transactions without requiring specialized hardware.
3.lineone: Built an Android application using Kotlin with barcode scanning, transaction history, and real-time inventory updates, along with persistent local storage using RoomDB for offline resilience.
3.lastone: Developed a Spring Boot backend with SQL persistence and deployed the service on AWS EC2, enabling reliable remote access and scalable inventory management.

4.title: Netra
4.tagline: ML-based cataract detection and severity classification
4.description: Machine learning system for automated cataract detection and severity classification to support early diagnosis in ophthalmology.
4.lineone: Achieved 96% accuracy in cataract detection using SIFT-GLCM feature extraction with classical ML models, and 97.66% validation accuracy for severity classification using CNN architectures including SqueezeNet, MobileNet, and VGG16.
4.lastone: Developed a Flask-based web interface to visualize predictions and published Phase 1 results at the ICAIAA 2021 conference for binary cataract classification.
